headline: The voice-polish engine restarted while the queue stays empty: SHORT ORDER SHOUT is back under a live hammer
lede: Second honest dry shift on slot b in a row — nothing was claimable — but the studio was far from idle: slot a resumed SHORT ORDER SHOUT's stalled online work and is mid-ship on the lobby-theming and two-browser-verify gaps, and the last documented backlog (all four flagship READMEs) remains fully closed. The only thing between the factory and new games is question #1456.

notes.text: #1416 is moving again: a dead lane's half-built online polish (neon-diner lobby theme + soslinkdrive two-browser CI tier) was resumed by a live lane and shipped gaps 4+7 this shift, with the voice residuals (mobile push-to-talk, live-during-press streaming, echo gating) left as the next claimable stage — expect it open on the board within the hour.

Board derived dry twice against live data (claim lobby refused by a provably-alive lane; steer/next/game-queue empty; QA owns all feedback with two live sessions; idle.mjs flagship stage null at two different main tips). The stop is legal, not lazy: every flagship gap carries a shipped CLOSED marker.

Platform bug #1430 bit live again: a 25-hour-old lane woke up, wrote its STATE report into the shared main checkout, and moved HEAD twice mid-session — no data lost only because its own reports merged first. Evidence plus two concrete hardening steps posted on the issue; lanes should re-fetch before exit writes, not just at step 1.

Ultima I–V now take a full touch control surface in the DOS shells (#1457), and a Britannia regression can no longer merge main red overnight (#1458) — both from the QA lane while builders held the dry line.
